other_failure_modes.name: Target leakage in target encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent calculates target encoding using the training fold's targets and applies it directly to the same training fold without out-of-fold estimation or smoothing. This causes severe target leakage into the training features and guarantees overfitting.

other_failure_modes.name: Test set leakage in feature engineering
other_failure_modes.description: The agent calculates global statistics (e.g., frequency encoding, group-wise means, and standard deviations) on the combined train and test dataset before splitting. This leaks the distribution and statistics of the test set into the training features.

summary: The agent correctly sets up cross-validation, models, and an optimized ensemble. However, there are two critical data leakage bugs: test set statistics are leaked into the training data during feature engineering, and target encoding is applied in-fold without smoothing or cross-validation, which will cause catastrophic overfitting.
